protocol.groups: fit-only population-weighted mean ANN hidden1 activation, tie channel index, eight groups of eight
protocol.pair_search: for each group retain best two negative and two positive offsets by the common ranking; enumerate all pairs of distinct groups
protocol.objective: overall event IoU, never average ordinary and HD IoUs
protocol.eligibility: IoU, overall recall, HD recall >= anchor; AC <= anchor; numerical comparison tolerance only
protocol.rank: eligible first, highest overall IoU, lower AC, fewer changed groups, smaller total m0 change, parameter id
protocol.main_selection: eligibility must hold on complete fit, complete internal validation and complete Main; rank by internal-validation overall IoU with the same tie order
protocol.diagnostics: changed-group winners may be ineligible; they are reported as tradeoffs, not promoted
protocol.freeze: seal fit shortlist before scoring internal validation; seal all Main choices before loading Dev
protocol.backend: unchanged GPU exact-count reference, fixed CPU explicit binary spike-add cross-checks
